entities.summary: Nicholas J. Antosca is an American film and television writer, producer, and novelist. He is the creator and showrunner of Channel Zero (2016–18) and A Friend of the Family. He also co-created and showran Hulu's The Act (2019) and Netflix's Brand New Cherry Flavor (2021).
